blocks.html: Robinsons Communities: Building ideal communities a step ahead with Escalades

Committed to providing todays’ homebuyers with smart and practical home choices, Robinsons Communities, the residential brand under Robinsons Land Corporation specializing in affordable and quality condominium projects, takes to heart its promise of providing a relaxed and welcoming neighborhood with its flourishing residential product concept - Escalades.

Escalades, from the Latin word “scala” or “to climb” has been elevating the lives of Filipino families by giving them a sensible home option that provides value for money in all the right aspects since 2008 when it introduced its first project – Escalades at 20th Avenue in Cubao, Quezon City.

The warm response which Escalades at 20th Avenue received when it launched spurred the growth of other Escalades developments in strategic locations around the Metro: Escalades South Metro, along Dr. A. Santos Avenue, Sucat, Muntinlupa, Escalades East Tower, located in 20th Avenue in Cubao Quezon City and finally, Acacia Escalades in Amang Rodriguez corner Calle Industria, Barangay Manggahan, Pasig City.

Ingenious architecture
All Escalades projects were defined by a unique Filipino design concept that equally provides aesthetic appeal and practical benefits to its residents. More specifically, the product takes design inspiration from the traditional Filipino icon, the bahay kubo or Nipa hut, which has always stood for its ingenious architecture.

Throughout the years, many have regarded the Nipa hut as an inspiration in space planning, as living and working spaces in it are contiguous yet clearly defined. During the design development phase of each Escalades development, the design team made reference to the Nipa hut for the buildings’ rooflines and building facade’s warm earth hues. The same details are also seen as you enter each development with the guardhouse’s rooflines and in some cases even in the amenities, as reflected in Escalades South Metro’s Briza clubhouse.

But while this concept is present in all of the developments, each project has a distinctive feature that makes it stand out. The amenities at Escalades at 20th Avenue have a tropical vibe to it with the modern-Asian landscaping treatments. Its neighboring residential project, Escalades East Tower, injects modern contemporary design elements, in the building facilities. On the other hand, Escalades South Metro and Acacia Escalades both emanate a modern-Filipiniana design, which is evident in the buildings’ color schemes and welcoming amenities.

Welcoming spaces
One can discern though, that the Filipino touch in every Escalades development transcends beyond its design. The Filipino tradition of deep family ties are taken into consideration with the mapping out of amenities and inviting open spaces.

From Escalades 20th Avenue, until the most recent residential development – Acacia Escalades, each project offers a nurturing and relaxing atmosphere ideal for intimate family bonding and community events and social gatherings.
An Escalades development close to you
Also characteristic of every Escalades development is the strategic address where each community is located. Every Escalades homeowner can enjoy the advantages of living in a prime yet less busy location lending to the development a quieter and more relaxed pace of living.
Once you enter each residential development, it feels like entering an expansive private village which has a calmer and more laidback lifestyle.

And the good thing about living in Escalades is that you can easily step out of your home and get easy access to offices, schools, commercial hubs and business establishments alongside with the benefit of having access to major thoroughfares and public transportation systems.

Even better, this Escalades concept is something that the Robinsons Communities brand through Robinsons Land plans to expand and put within reach of every Filipino family, which means wherever you might be at the moment, expect an Escalades community to open its doors near you soon!
Robinsons Communities promise of quality and affordability

Thoughtful design planning resulting to a unique and functional design concept, open spaces and facilities that fostering a warm and welcoming community atmosphere and choice locations that are close to the things you value the most, these are the things that make Escalades developments a stand-out home choice. And ultimately for the smart home buyer, decision making is made easier with Robinsons Communities’ promise of quality and affordability.

With a variety of unit types and finishes to choose from, friendly and flexible payments schemes that are matched according to your lifestyle, Escalades is a place you’ll definitely want to call your own. Move into an Escalades home today and move one step ahead!
